plugins.name: migration-guard
plugins.description: Static safety analyzer for database schema migrations: flags table-locking, table-rewriting, and data-loss operations (Postgres SQL + Rails/Django/Alembic) and suggests online-safe rewrites.

plugins.name: llm-app-doctor
plugins.description: Static auditor for AI/LLM integration code: flags leaked API keys, prompt-injection sinks, retired/deprecated model IDs, parameters that now 400 on current models, missing generation limits, and prompt-cache busters (Anthropic + OpenAI, Python + JS/TS).
